name: Savee
summary: Curated visual-inspiration platform where designers save images and videos into boards, with color and visual search.
description: An ad-free, curated inspiration platform: members save images and videos from anywhere on the web into boards, discover work by exact color, tags or visual similarity, and collaborate in team workspaces. Ships a Figma plugin, browser extension, iOS and Android apps, a marketplace of 80+ templates and assets, and a read-only REST API plus an official MCP server for assistants.
contains: save images and videos into boards, shared with teams
search by exact color, tag or visual similarity
ad-free; funded by Pro and Team subscriptions
Figma plugin, browser extension, iOS and Android apps
read-only REST API and official MCP server with OAuth 2.1
